cause: Training/serving skew on f1. For all 200 entities present in both the training_sample and serving_log, features f2-f5 match exactly while f1 differs on every row. The relationship is srv_f1 = exp(train_f1) - 1 (equivalently train_f1 = log1p(srv_f1) = log(1 + srv_f1)). The training pipeline applies a log1p (log(1+x)) transform to f1, but the online serving path serves the raw, un-logged value, so the model is trained on log-scaled f1 yet served raw-scaled f1 at inference time.
